blocks: How Do I Plan a Whole-Home Remodel, Including Budgeting and Timeline Expectations?

Plan Your Whole-Home Remodel with Clarity

A whole-home remodel is an opportunity to shape every part of your home around the way you live. It also requires informed decisions about design priorities, construction scope, investment, and timing before work begins. AB Bespoke Home helps Sacramento-area homeowners plan highly tailored renovations with a clear path from early ideas through completion.

Whether you are updating an older property, improving flow between rooms, expanding for a growing household, or preparing for a long-term stay, the right plan keeps your goals connected. Thoughtful preconstruction planning helps you understand what is possible, where your budget has the greatest impact, and what to expect during each stage of the project.

Build a Budget Around Your Priorities

Your whole-home remodel budget should reflect the scope of work, the level of finishes you prefer, and the existing conditions of your home. Structural changes, home additions, kitchen and bathroom renovations, custom details, and new systems can all affect the overall investment. Beginning with a realistic budget range allows the project team to guide design and material decisions in a way that supports your priorities.

Rather than trying to upgrade every area equally, it helps to identify the spaces and features that matter most to your household. You may place the greatest value on a kitchen designed for entertaining, a more functional primary suite, improved natural light, or connected indoor and outdoor living areas.

  • Define your must-have improvements and your nice-to-have features

  • Consider the condition and age of existing systems and structures

  • Set aside room in the budget for conditions discovered during construction

  • Select materials and finishes that fit your vision and long-term plans

  • Review the full project scope before construction begins

Set Realistic Timeline Expectations

A whole-home remodel takes time because each phase builds on the one before it. Planning, design, selections, permits when required, material ordering, and construction all influence the schedule. Larger renovations, additions, and projects involving significant layout changes generally require more coordination than a single-room update.

Early decisions help protect the construction timeline. When plans, specifications, and key selections are made before work starts, the team can better coordinate trades, order materials, and prepare for the work ahead. Changes during construction can still be addressed, but they may affect cost and schedule. Clear communication gives you a better understanding of progress, upcoming decisions, and what is happening in your home.

Know What to Expect From the Process

The planning process begins with a detailed conversation about your home, lifestyle, goals, and project priorities. From there, AB Bespoke Home works with you to define the scope, develop a workable plan, and align the project around your desired level of craftsmanship and customization. This early stage is where many of the most important decisions are made.

Once the plan is established, construction can move forward with a shared understanding of the work involved. You should expect regular communication, organized coordination, and guidance as your project progresses. For occupied homes, planning also includes practical discussions about access, work areas, temporary disruptions, and how your household can prepare for construction.

Choose a Partner Focused on Your Home

AB Bespoke Home specializes in luxury residential remodeling, home additions, and new construction for Sacramento-area homeowners. With more than a decade of experience, our team understands that a successful whole-home remodel depends on more than attractive finishes. It requires careful planning, dependable communication, skilled craftsmanship, and attention to how every space works together.

As you prepare for a whole-home remodel, focus on decisions that support how your household will use the home over time. A clear scope, realistic budget, thoughtful selections, and an organized timeline can help create a finished space that feels personal, functional, and cohesive.

Bring Clarity To Your Remodeling Decisions

At AB Bespoke Home, we help homeowners turn big-picture goals into a practical path forward. If you are asking how do I plan a whole-home remodel, including budgeting and timeline expectations?, our team can discuss your home, priorities, and next steps. Contact us to start a conversation about your project.

blocks: Pride in Exceptional Craftsmanship

AB Bespoke Home is a family-owned business specializing in residential new construction, renovations, and additions. We serve busy professionals who prioritize craftsmanship and are looking for an elevated building experience. With attention to both detail and design, we approach every project with a focus on functional luxury, efficient delivery, and clear communication; with a top Sacramento Builder like AB Bespoke Home, you’ll never be left guessing.

Your home is where you spend most of your time and, therefore, should bring you a deep sense of joy and reflect your unique style. By getting to know you and your family, we go beyond construction to bring an experience that fits your busy lifestyle.

We’re proudly based in Northern California, but provide design and consulting services nationwide.
Meet the Owner: Aaron Byrne

My passion for building started long before I picked up a tool belt. As a toddler, my first memories include riding heavy equipment around an old family property and watching my Paw Paw work. I spent childhood weekends assisting with my dad’s ‘honey do’ list, learning how to build basic furniture and execute everyday home repairs. I built my first shed at seven and saved up enough allowance money to buy a backpack leaf blower by twelve years old; I took on my own landscaping and cleanup jobs that summer. In seventh grade I was re-roofing homes with a volunteer organization and during high school I worked summers on a family friend’s construction sites learning everything I could. Watching homes come to life from the ground up sparked something in me early on — a deep appreciation for the craft, the precision, and the pride that goes into quality construction.

Throughout college and the ensuing years, I lost touch with the joy of creating something out of nothing. I entered management consulting and cut my teeth learning the ins and outs of corporate America. While I wasn’t building homes, I did gain hands-on experience in problem analysis and project management; I mastered the art of difficult conversations and cut my teeth with executive-level communications in boardrooms and corner offices.

Eventually, that early curiosity led me back to building. I worked alongside seasoned pros, re learned the ins and outs of residential construction, and slowly began to develop my own approach — one grounded in clear communication, thoughtful design, and attention to the little details that make a house truly feel like home.

I launched AB Bespoke Home here in Sacramento with a simple goal: to offer busy professionals a better construction experience. That means no shortcuts and no surprises — just reliable craftsmanship, personalized service, and results built to last. Every project we take on is a chance to help someone bring their vision to life, and that’s a responsibility we don’t take lightly. We do the right thing for the right reason because every project is treated as our own.

Contact us.

We’re here to help you envision and create your dream home.

Projects

University
University Whole Home Remodel in Rio Del Oro

A fast-tracked whole home renovation designed for modern family living, blending mid-century character with elevated contemporary finishes in one of Sacramento’s most established neighborhoods.

A Whole Home Transformation Designed Around Time, Function, and Craftsmanship

When the homeowners purchased this property in Sacramento’s Rio Del Oro neighborhood, they saw the potential for a long-term family home — but they also saw a house that no longer reflected the way they wanted to live.

Having outgrown their previous home, the couple needed more space for their family while maintaining a refined, cohesive aesthetic that felt intentional from room to room. Like many buyers in Sacramento’s competitive housing market, they chose to purchase a larger home with strong architectural character rather than compete for a fully renovated property at a premium price.

Their vision was clear from the beginning: transform the outdated home into a warm, modern interpretation of its original mid-century roots — and complete the work before move-in.

With only a narrow window between closing on the property and vacating their previous home, timing became just as important as craftsmanship.

AB Bespoke Home was selected to manage the complete renovation because of our ability to coordinate complex, multi-phase residential projects while maintaining clear communication, schedule accountability, and a highly detailed finish standard throughout the process.

Preserving Mid-Century Character While Introducing a Modern California Aesthetic

The homeowners were drawn to the home’s original architectural character, particularly the existing terrazzo tile in the entryway. Rather than remove those details, the design direction focused on extending and modernizing them throughout the home.

White Oak Hardwood Flooring Installed and Finished In Place

One of the defining features of the renovation was the installation of solid white oak hardwood flooring throughout the home.

Existing carpet was removed and replaced with site-finished hardwood flooring that was sanded and stained in place to create a seamless, custom appearance. The finished floors became the visual foundation of the entire remodel, bringing warmth, continuity, and a distinctly elevated feel to every room.

The natural oak tones paired intentionally with modern fixtures, clean-lined cabinetry, and layered textures to create a sophisticated but comfortable family environment.

A Complete Kitchen Renovation

The kitchen was fully reimagined with all-new cabinetry, updated appliances, modern hardware, and refined finish selections that aligned with the home’s updated architectural direction.

Careful attention was given to balancing functionality with aesthetics, ensuring the space could support the day-to-day demands of a growing family while still feeling polished and cohesive within the larger home design.

Modernized Bathrooms with Elevated Materials and Finishes

Every bathroom in the home received a complete cosmetic renovation.

Updates included:

  • New tile flooring

  • Updated countertops

  • Modern plumbing fixtures

  • New shower hardware

  • Updated lighting

  • Coordinated bathroom accessories and finish hardware

In the secondary bathroom, the existing tiled shower walls were upgraded to solid surface stone wall panels, creating a cleaner, more contemporary appearance with improved long-term durability and reduced maintenance.

To reinforce continuity throughout the home, terrazzo tile selections inspired by the original entry flooring were incorporated into the laundry room and bathroom spaces.

Coordinating a Complex Renovation on a Tight Timeline

The greatest challenge of the project was not structural complexity — it was time.

Because the homeowners needed the house completed before moving in, the renovation required an extremely organized construction schedule with carefully sequenced trades, material coordination, and proactive communication throughout every phase.

By maintaining the original locations of plumbing and electrical fixtures and avoiding structural modifications, AB Bespoke Home was able to complete the project without requiring formal permitting, significantly reducing delays and accelerating the renovation timeline.

At the same time, critical infrastructure improvements were still addressed where necessary.

Finishing Details That Elevated the Entire Home

Beyond the larger renovation elements, the project included extensive finish upgrades throughout the property.

These details included:

  • New interior and exterior paint

  • Replacement interior doors

  • Updated casing, molding, and baseboards

  • Modern lighting fixtures throughout the home

  • New cabinet hardware and door hardware

  • Coordinated bathroom accessories including towel bars, hooks, rings, and paper holders

Every finish was selected to support the home’s updated mid-century modern identity while maintaining a timeless and approachable feel appropriate for family living.

Helping the Homeowners Fully Settle Into Their New Space

One of the most rewarding moments of the project came after construction was complete.

Initially, the homeowners mentioned that the new house did not feel dramatically larger than the home they had previously outgrown. During a follow-up visit for minor cabinet adjustments after move-in, the AB Bespoke Home team recognized that the family had naturally recreated many of the same living patterns from their former house.

Spaces like the expanded dining room remained largely unused simply because they had never previously had those areas available to them.

Through continued communication and guidance, the homeowners began fully utilizing the home in the way it was designed to function — transforming the property from simply a larger house into a more intentional and elevated way of living for their family. This went beyond construction to suggest new rituals that have since become the family standard: nightly shared meals around the dinner table.

Luxury Remodeling for Busy Sacramento Professionals

At AB Bespoke Home, we understand that successful remodeling requires more than quality construction.

For busy professionals and growing families, the real value comes from having a builder capable of managing timelines, coordinating trades, maintaining communication, and executing complex renovations with consistency and precision.

The Blackmer Remodel reflects our commitment to delivering thoughtful, high-end residential renovations that balance craftsmanship, organization, and livability from start to finish.

Planning a Whole Home Remodel in Sacramento?

Whether you are updating a recently purchased home or transforming a long-term residence, AB Bespoke Home specializes in carefully managed renovations designed around craftsmanship, communication, and modern family living. Reach out now to learn how we can help.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a whole home remodel in Sacramento take?

Timeline depends on project scope, permitting requirements, and material selections. Projects that avoid structural changes can often move significantly faster.

Can you remodel a home before move-in?

Yes. Many homeowners choose to complete renovations immediately after purchasing a property to avoid living through construction.

What is included in a whole home renovation?

Whole home remodels can include kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, paint, lighting, finish carpentry, electrical upgrades, and more.

Does AB Bespoke Home specialize in mid-century modern renovations?

Yes. We frequently help homeowners preserve original architectural character while introducing updated finishes and modern functionality.

Roxburgh
Arden Park, Sacramento Phased Whole Home Remodel

Roxburgh: A Remodel in Step with Daily Life

Project Overview

Location: Arden Park, Sacramento, CA
Project Type: Full Home Remodel (Phased Renovation)
Scope: Kitchen, Living Room, Home Office, Owner’s Suite, Bathrooms, Laundry Room
Timeline: 2.5 Years
Investment: ~$250-300K

A Whole-Home Vision, Built Over Time

Originally a classic 1980s home, the Roxburgh property had been updated in pieces over the years—resulting in a disconnected mix of styles, finishes, and layouts. Like many Sacramento homes of this era, it featured outdated carpet and tile throughout, with no cohesive design direction tying the spaces together.

The homeowners—a growing family with an eye toward real estate investment—wanted to transform the home into a modern, functional space that could evolve with their needs. At the same time, they needed to approach the renovation strategically, completing the work in phases due to budget and timing constraints.

From the beginning, the goal was clear: create a unified, high-quality home that felt intentional—no matter how long it took to complete.

Client Goals

  • Create a cohesive, modern aesthetic throughout the entire home

  • Improve functionality for a growing family living through construction

  • Prioritize durable, long-lasting materials suitable for future rental use

  • Increase overall property value in the Arden Park Sacramento market

  • Execute the renovation in phases without sacrificing the final vision

The Challenge: Phased Renovation Without Losing Cohesion

Phased remodels often lead to disjointed results—but this project required the opposite.

The homeowners needed to:

  • Live in the home during construction

  • Spread investment over multiple years

  • Prioritize certain spaces based on immediate lifestyle needs

Without a clear long-term plan, this type of project can easily become another patchwork renovation. The challenge was ensuring every phase contributed to a single, cohesive end result.

The AB Bespoke Approach

What set this project apart was the strategy.

Before any construction began, AB Bespoke Home developed a complete vision for the entire property—including design direction, layout improvements, material selections, and a phased execution plan.

This allowed the homeowners to move forward with confidence, knowing that every decision supported the final outcome.

Phase 1: Structural + Foundational Updates

Before move-in, we completed all major disruptive work:

  • Select flooring replacement

  • Wall removals to improve layout and flow

  • Drywall repair

  • Full interior repaint

This created a clean, unified baseline for the rest of the project.

Phase 2: Kitchen Remodel

As the heart of the home, the kitchen was the top priority. Designed for a family that loves to cook, the space was reimagined to be open, functional, and visually cohesive with the long-term design plan. Because this was a family of chefs, the Kitchen was a top priority for them. New cabinetry, an updated layout with expanded countertop space and room for a coffee bar, layered lighting, and modern appliances made this kitchen the centerpiece of the newly refreshed home.

Phase 3: Home Office

With hybrid work schedules for the husband and wife, a dedicated and highly functional home office became essential. This phase focused on productivity, comfort, and integration with the home’s overall aesthetic. Undertaken during a family vacation, custom cabinetry was installed and painted in place for a high-end look that could be executed while the family was away to minimize lifestyle disruptions.

Phase 4: Secondary Spaces

Laundry room and children’s bathroom updates were completed to improve day-to-day functionality while aligning with the broader design vision. These ‘workhorse’ spaces can sometimes be overlooked in a remodel because they aren’t always the most glamorous. In reality, we all need to do laundry and having a functional space to do so can take the dread out of an otherwise mundane task.

Phase 5: Owner’s Suite Transformation

When the timing was right, we completed the final phase:

  • Full primary bedroom refresh

  • Completely redesigned layout

  • Removal of the bathtub to create a large, shared shower

  • Elevated, luxury finishes to create a truly tranquil retreat

Design & Features

  • Cohesive flooring and finish palette carried throughout the home

  • Durable material selections designed for long-term use and rental potential

  • Open-concept improvements to enhance flow and livability

  • Custom kitchen designed for serious home cooking

  • Expanded walk-in shower in the primary suite

Campus Commons
Campus Commons Bathroom Remodel

A thoughtfully planned luxury bathroom renovation completed in just 10 days — allowing the homeowners to leave for vacation and return to two fully transformed bathrooms without the disruption of living through construction.

Renovating Two Bathrooms Without Disrupting Daily Life

For many homeowners, the most stressful part of remodeling is not the investment or even the design decisions — it is the disruption.

Construction often means weeks of noise, dust, scheduling complications, and strangers moving in and out of the home throughout the day. For busy professionals and families, that disruption alone can delay renovation projects for years.

When these Campus Commons homeowners approached AB Bespoke Home, they proposed a different idea.

Knowing they had an extended vacation planned, they asked whether it would be possible to fully renovate both of their bathrooms while they were away — minimizing the impact construction would have on their day-to-day lives.

We immediately recognized the opportunity.

What followed was a months-long planning and coordination process designed to ensure that every decision, finish selection, and construction detail was finalized before the homeowners ever left town.

The goal was simple: Deliver two fully transformed bathrooms with virtually zero disruption to the homeowners’ lives.

Advanced Planning Made the Entire Project Possible

Successfully completing two full bathroom renovations in only 10 days required far more than efficient construction.

It required trust, communication, and an extraordinary level of preparation.

Before demolition ever began, AB Bespoke Home worked closely with the homeowners for several months to finalize every aspect of the renovation. Together, we carefully developed the project down to the smallest details so construction could proceed without hesitation once the homeowners departed for their trip.

Every Detail Was Finalized Before Construction Began

Selections and planning included:

  • Tile size and layout

  • Grout color and spacing

  • Plumbing fixture selections

  • Vanity and mirror placement

  • Lighting layouts

  • Paint colors

  • Hardware finishes

  • Towel bar and accessory placement

  • Toilet specifications tailored to each bathroom’s intended use

Even subtle functional details were intentionally considered, including selecting different toilet heights for each bathroom based on how the spaces would be used day to day.

Because the homeowners would be unavailable during construction, every decision had to be made confidently and collaboratively before work began.

The project was effectively built on paper long before it was built in the home.

A Timeless Design with Personalized Character

The homeowners wanted a design that felt fresh and personal while remaining timeless enough to age gracefully over the years.

The final aesthetic blended classic forms with selective moments of color and texture, creating bathrooms that felt both refined and expressive without relying on short-term design trends.

Elevated Materials and Finishes

Both bathrooms were fully demolished down to the studs and rebuilt with updated layouts, materials, and finishes.

The renovations included:

  • Marble tile installation

  • New vanities

  • Updated lighting

  • Modern plumbing fixtures

  • New mirrors

  • Fresh paint

  • Updated flooring

  • Coordinated hardware and accessories

  • New toilets

  • Solid surface stone tub surrounds

In the primary bathroom, one of the defining design features became the custom reeded glass detail suggested by the AB Bespoke Home team — a subtle architectural element that added texture, privacy, and visual sophistication to the finished space.

The homeowners immediately connected with the concept, and it ultimately became one of the most memorable elements of the renovation.

Finishing Two Full Bathroom Remodels in 10 Days

Once the homeowners left for vacation, the construction phase moved quickly.

Over the course of just 10 days, AB Bespoke Home coordinated demolition, plumbing, electrical work, tile installation, finish carpentry, painting, fixture installation, and final detailing across both bathrooms simultaneously.

Because every detail had already been planned and approved in advance, construction proceeded efficiently without delays, uncertainty, or decision bottlenecks.

The result was a streamlined renovation process that felt unusually calm and organized despite the aggressive timeline.

For the homeowners, the experience was remarkably simple: They left for vacation and returned home to two completely transformed bathrooms.

Remodeling Without the Typical Daily Stressors of Construction

One of the most rewarding aspects of this project was proving that high-end remodeling does not always need to disrupt everyday life.

Through careful planning, transparent communication, and disciplined project management, AB Bespoke Home was able to remove many of the frustrations homeowners commonly associate with construction projects.

There was:

  • No living through demolition

  • No daily construction noise

  • No navigating dust and debris

  • No weeks of coordinating around tradespeople

  • No loss of bathroom access during daily routines

Instead, the homeowners were able to fully disconnect, enjoy their vacation, and return to a finished home environment that already felt complete and intentional.

Creative Project Planning for Busy Sacramento Homeowners

At AB Bespoke Home, we believe successful remodeling starts long before construction begins.

For homeowners balancing demanding careers, family schedules, and busy lives, thoughtful planning and communication are often just as important as craftsmanship itself.

The Campus Commons Bathroom Remodel reflects our ability to think creatively, build trust with clients, and execute highly detailed renovations in ways that minimize disruption without compromising quality.

By combining advanced planning with organized project management and refined craftsmanship, we help homeowners experience remodeling differently — with clarity, confidence, and far less stress.

Whether you are renovating before move-in, remodeling while traveling, or simply looking for a contractor who values organization and communication as much as craftsmanship, AB Bespoke Home helps Sacramento homeowners complete thoughtful renovations with minimal disruption to daily life. Bathroom remodel timelines depend on scope, material selections, and planning. With extensive preparation and scheduling, some projects can be completed on accelerated timelines.

Yes. With proper planning and communication, homeowners can minimize disruption by scheduling renovations during vacations or travel periods.

blocks: The AB Bespoke Home Construction Process

Start working with AB Bespoke Home

Start by navigating to our Contact page and filling out a short questionnaire. Please include your name, email address, and a phone number where you can be reached. Tell us about your project goals (e.g. kitchen remodel to meet the needs of our growing family), desired timeline, and expected budget.

Outreach and follow-up

With your initial information in hand, we’ll set up a quick phone call to verify a few details. This should take approximately 15 minutes and will confirm we are able to realize your vision as your building partner; we want to ensure your project aligns with one of our services. From here, most clients opt for a paid, in-person meeting ($150) to show us their space and meet our team. These meetings typically take 1-2 hours and allow us to gather additional details about your project while sharing more about our process; you’ll have full access to our expert team to get all your initial questions answered. While the associated fee is not refundable it will be deducted from your final payment when we move forward with an agreement to work together.

Pre-Construction Agreement

Diving deeper into your project, we’ll work to nail down your design aesthetic, select materials, and ensure overall viability. We’ll create a detailed schedule and accurate budget you can count on, pull in other necessary professionals (architect, engineers, trade partners, etc.), and get all required pieces in place to start your project. This will include coordinating with your municipality to pull requisite permits. This process can take 1-6 months depending on project complexity. A major goal of the pre-construction process is to avoid changes down the road, ultimately saving you time and unnecessary expense.

Homeowners who commit to our full Pre Construction process are eligible for our Signature Guarantee.

Project Execution

After an exhaustive pre-construction process, your project will be fully built… on paper. The fun can now begin on bringing your vision to life in the real world. You’ll quickly see our team on site creating (managed) dust and doing the physical work to bring your project to life. This process will last anywhere from a few weeks to a year or longer based on the scope of work; you’ll have a clear idea of the exact timeline before the first hammer is swung, though project changes after this point may add time to your project.
Our Blog provides a more detailed explanation of our process.

Surita

Mariemont Full Home Remodel in Sacramento

The Surita Street Project

Project Overview

Location: Marymont, Sacramento, CA
Project Type: Full Home Remodel (Fast-Track Renovation)
Scope: Kitchen, Bathrooms, Flooring, Doors & Trim, HVAC Relocation, Exterior Landscaping
Timeline: 2–3 Months
Project Goal: Full transformation before move-in

A Full Transformation on a Tight Deadline

When these homeowners purchased their new property on Surita Street, they faced a unique challenge: they needed a complete renovation finished in just a few short months.

Coming from a previously remodeled home with modern, high-end finishes, they weren’t willing to compromise their lifestyle by moving into an outdated space. At the same time, a leaseback agreement on their current home meant their move-in date was fixed, and fast approaching!

The home itself required significant updates—from an aging kitchen and worn finishes to outdated systems and layout inefficiencies.

The mission was clear: deliver a fully updated, move-in-ready home—without extending the timeline.

Client Goals

  • Complete a full home remodel within a strict 2–3 month timeline

  • Match the level of finish and quality from their previous renovated home

  • Create a luxury kitchen designed for everyday use

  • Open up and improve the functionality of the entryway

  • Replace outdated materials with durable, high-quality upgrades throughout

The Challenges: Speed Without Compromise

Fast-track renovations often require trade-offs—but in this case, quality couldn’t slip.

Key challenges included:

  • A highly compressed construction timeline

  • Coordinating multiple trades simultaneously

  • Delivering high-end finishes under tight timeline pressures

  • Solving layout and mechanical issues quickly

One of the most significant obstacles was the home’s HVAC system, which was located directly in the entryway—taking up valuable space and limiting the home’s first impression. In exchange for a front door furnace, we were able to relocate the mechanicals to the attic and provide a much-needed coat closet and expanded entryway.

The AB Bespoke Home Approach

This project highlighted AB Bespoke Home’s ability to act as a single, coordinated team—handling design, engineering, and construction under one roof.

While it may intuitively seem quicker to have different teams working together simultaneously to reach and end goal in time, this would actually be a case of ‘too many cooks in the kitchen.’ This situation demands a single clear leader capable of coordinating the chaotic symphony of construction. With a clear plan and tight coordination, AB Bespoke Home executed multiple upgrades in parallel while maintaining quality and communication.

Kitchen Transformation

The kitchen became the centerpiece of the home:

  • Full gut renovation

  • New custom cabinetry

  • New countertops

  • Hardwood flooring throughout

  • High-end appliances

A standout feature was the addition of a pot filler, a must-have detail that elevated both function and luxury for a client who loves to cook.

Whole-Home Upgrades

To create a cohesive and elevated feel throughout the home we:

  • Replaced all hollow-core doors with solid-core doors, including adding new door casings for a fresh look

  • Installed new baseboards throughout the home, not only over the sections of new hardwood flooring

  • Installed new AND repaired old hardwood flooring - ALL of it was refinished

  • Applied a full interior repaint

These upgrades eliminated the “dated” feel and created consistency across every space.

Bathroom Renovations

Both bathrooms were fully updated with a focus on durability and modern design:

Bathroom One:

  • Marble solid-surface wall surrounds replacing tile

  • New vanity, countertops, plumbing fixtures, and toilet

  • New marble tile floor to match the upgraded tub surrounds

Bathroom Two:

  • Reconfigured layout by removing a wall

  • Installed a glass-enclosed shower to open up the space

  • New tile flooring, vanity, countertops, and plumbing fixtures

HVAC Relocation & Entryway Improvement

One of the most impactful upgrades involved relocating the HVAC system:

  • Moved unit from entryway to attic

  • Installed new ducting and refrigerant lines

  • Built a new attic platform for the system

This transformation opened up the entryway, significantly improving both layout and first impression.

Exterior Refresh

To complete the transformation, we updated the home’s exterior landscaping—creating a cohesive look that matched the fully renovated interior.

Design & Features

  • Luxury kitchen with high-end appliances and pot filler

  • Solid-core doors and upgraded trim throughout

  • Refinished hardwood flooring

  • Marble bathroom surrounds

  • Glass-enclosed shower for improved spatial flow

  • Relocated HVAC system for better layout and functionality

  • Updated exterior landscaping

The Results

In a matter of months, this outdated home was transformed into a fully modern, move-in-ready space that matched the quality and comfort of the client’s previous home.

Despite the aggressive timeline, the project delivered:

  • A cohesive, high-end aesthetic throughout

  • Improved layout and functionality

Build your forever home with AB Bespoke Home's custom construction services in Sacramento.
